newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman raises UAL EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman raises UAL EPS estimate.

text.p: - Lehman Brothers said it raised its 1997 fully-distributed earnings per share estimate for UAL Corp to $8.70 from $8.25.
- Lehman also raised its 12-month stock price target to $72 from $70 and reaffirmed its buy rating on the airline.
- UAL has "significant" untapped potential in its hub-and-spoke operations, especially in Los Angeles, Lehman said.
- The airline recently told analysts it sees unit revenue growth of two to three percent in 1997, including a three-month benefit from next year's lapsed passenger excise tax.
- Lehman expects UAL to show 1.8 percent year-over-year unit revenue growth, which includes two full quarters of a lapsed excise tax.

- Lehamn said UAL should benefit from low-cost carrier growth shifting to the East Coast, where UAL does not have a strong presence. UAL has succeeded in slowing the growth of low-cost carriers in its core markets, Lehman said.
